basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate from Mumbai, India, currently working as a junior software developer. I've always been fascinated by gaming, particularly RPGs like the Fallout series. In my free time, I enjoy exploring new tech gadgets and delving into the world of cryptocurrencies. I'm single and often browse Reddit during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have always been a tech enthusiast. I taught myself about cryptocurrencies through online courses and forums. Gaming has been a passion since childhood, and I've recently started exploring game modding.
